Since secret-ballot approval voting is easy to setup using Doodle, I
created a poll for the name. Go vote here:

http://doodle.com/intqfgg4kskkn6ai

p.s. Apparently strategic voting on Doodle polls is a thing!

Strategic Voting Behavior in Doodle Polls
